observation.command:
cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec curl -sL http://localhost/ -o /workspace/.home.html
echo "=== Homepage title ==="; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /workspace/.home.html | head -1
echo "=== OpenCulturas branding present? ==="; grep -ioE "openculturas" /workspace/.home.html | head -1
echo "=== Admin ULI (functional login) ==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush uli 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== drush core:version + profile ==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush core:version 2>&1 | head -2
echo "=== node content created by distribution install? ==="; runuser -u dev -- ddev drush ev "echo 'node count: ' . \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('node')->getQuery()->count()->execute();" 2>&1 | tail -1
rm -f /workspace/.home.html
